- affordances: What actions can be performed with or on the entity, separated by semicolons (e.g., "cut;grasp;open"). If not available, output "N/A".
- constraints: Rules, or prohibitions associated with the entity, separated by semicolons (e.g., "keep_away_from_children;sharp_edges"). If not available, output "N/A".
- temporal: Temporal information related to the entity. If not available, output "N/A".

  ASSOCIATION=general thematic association
Format each relationship as ("relationship"<|><source_entity><|><target_entity><|><relationship_description><|><relationship_keywords><|><relationship_strength><|><relationship_type>)

- affordances: What actions can be performed with or on the entity, separated by semicolons (e.g., "cut;grasp;open"). If not available, output "N/A".
- constraints: Rules, or prohibitions associated with the entity, separated by semicolons (e.g., "keep_away_from_children;sharp_edges"). If not available, output "N/A".

  CAUSALITY=one entity causes, enables, or leads to the other;
  TEMPORAL=entities share a time or sequential relationship;
  SPATIAL=entities share a location or spatial relationship;

Format each relationship as ("relationship"<|><source_entity><|><target_entity><|><relationship_description><|><relationship_keywords><|><relationship_strength><|><relationship_type>)
